Priya: Quick plan for a compact on-prem beta: target 6 partners (mix fintech, healthcare, infra). 8-week pilot. Success metrics: p90 latency within 1.3x hosted baseline & token cost delta <=15%. Integration effort target <=40 eng hours. Thoughts on screening and incentives?

Sam: Two cohorts: 3 deep integrators (help with kernel/ops) + 3 API-only. Screening: infra type, expected QPS, compliance requirements, SLA owner.

Evan: Add hardware min spec (e.g., 2xA10) and kernel compatibility checklist. Need a deploy window and rollback plan per partner.

Maya: Feedback cadence: weekly for first 3 weeks, then biweekly. Eval suite: latency (p50/p90), hallucination/regression checks, tokens/inference, integration survey.

Jordan: Legal: require anonymized telemetry agreement + marketing opt-out. Also request a 48h rollback SLA. I'll draft consent.

Priya: Incentives: 3 months discounted Dedicated or $10k engineering credit + 40h SE time + priority triage + co-marketing on success.

Sam: I'll make intake form and outreach copy. Evan: can you produce infra checklist by Wed? Maya: eval harness by Wed? Jordan: consent by Thu?

dp-bot: Form created: "On-Prem Beta Intake" (ID 3fK2). Link posted in #product.

Priya: Thanks — sync Thurs 10am to review responses. Drop updates here if you can't make.
